items.text: Let it be. Simon's "build fire"/"start fire" missed only because the camp-rest triggers require the article ("*build a fire*"), and he recovered in seven seconds with `rest` — he's at full health by the fire right now. Speaking would land on top of the best line in that room. The trigger fix (`*build fire*`, `*start fire*`, `*make fire*`) is for a build turn, not this one.
